exceptions.title: lets a user handler prevent the status update
exceptions.reason: The status is not a change that a listener cancels, and `preventVaseUIHandler` does not exist (rule 8.7). A developer who wants no picture renders no `Avatar.Image`.

exceptions.title: triggers enter animation via data-starting-style when mounting
exceptions.reason: A `<Transition>` around `Avatar.Image` gives the enter classes (rule 8.9). `Avatar.test.ts` tests them.

exceptions.title: applies data-ending-style before unmount
exceptions.reason: A `<Transition>` around `Avatar.Image` gives the leave classes (rule 8.9).

exceptions.title: does not apply data-ending-style with keepMounted
exceptions.reason: The part has no `data-ending-style` (rule 8.9). With `keepMounted`, a CSS transition on `[data-loading]` animates the image.

The state has no `transitionStatus`, and the image has no `data-starting-style` or `data-ending-style`: a `<Transition>` around `Avatar.Image` gives the enter and the leave with its classes and hooks (rule 8.9). With `keepMounted`, a CSS transition on `[data-loading]` animates the image. A Boolean prop of Vue is `false` when the developer does not give it, so `keepMounted` has no default of its own.
